title: EdgeTX Package Manifest
description: JSON Schema for the EdgeTX edgetx.yml package manifest format (edgetx_format_version 1.x). Every manifest has the same shape: base manifests and variant manifests are both complete, self-contained manifests that declare their own package.id and package.description. See docs/Manifest.md#conformance-and-terminology.

edgetx_format_version.description: Revision of the EdgeTX package file format this manifest conforms to, as MAJOR.MINOR (e.g. "1.0"). Absent means "1.0". The same field and numbering appear in PKG/installed.yml. Tooling MUST refuse a MAJOR it does not know, and MUST process a known MAJOR with a higher MINOR while ignoring fields it does not recognise. See docs/Manifest.md.

requires.description: Other packages this package needs. See docs/Manifest.md#requires--other-packages.

safeRelativePath.description: A relative path using '/' separators. No '.' or '..' segment, no leading or trailing '/', no empty segment, no '\', no character that terminates a line in any common runtime (U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F, U+2028, U+2029), no segment ending in a space or a dot (FAT32 strips those on create), and none of the characters FAT32 forbids in a name (: * ? " < > |). The reserved 'PKG/' namespace is rejected case-insensitively, because a content `path` is the install destination when `dest` is absent. The single value '.' means the source root itself. See docs/Manifest.md#path-rules.

safeRelativeDest.description: Like safeRelativePath, but '.' is rejected (it would install into the SD card root) and the reserved 'PKG/' namespace is rejected, compared case-insensitively because FAT32 does not distinguish 'PKG' from 'pkg'. See docs/Manifest.md#path-rules.

packageId.description: Canonical package identifier: the git repo location without scheme, plus any subpackage path. At least host/owner/repo (3 slash-separated segments); the first segment must contain a dot. No segment may end in '.git', compared case-insensitively — the suffix belongs to a clone URL, not to an identity. The id is case-insensitive throughout and is lowercased before being stored or compared, because it becomes a FAT32 filename in PKG/files/. Capped at 249 characters so that name stays within the FAT32 limit. See docs/Manifest.md#package-id.

versionRequirement.description: Semver range the dependency's package.version must satisfy. Absent or '*' means any version. One comparator ('1.2.3', '=1.2.3', '^1.2.0', '~1.2.0', '>=1.2.0', '<2.0.0'), or two space-separated comparators forming a bounded range ('>=1.2.0 <2.0.0'). See docs/Manifest.md#version-ranges.

absoluteHttpUrl.description: Absolute URL using the http or https scheme. Other schemes are rejected: tooling may render these as links, and `javascript:` or `data:` would be an active-content sink for metadata fetched from a repository the tool does not control. Validated by pattern as well as by format, because the 'uri' format assertion is inert in validators lacking optional dependencies. See docs/Manifest.md#package-fields.

packageBlock.description: Package metadata. `id` and `description` are required in every manifest, including variant manifests. `additionalProperties` is deliberately true: unknown keys must be ignorable so that a MINOR spec bump stays backward compatible.

name.description: Human-friendly display name. Falls back to id when absent. Never affects install destinations.

description.description: Non-empty human-readable description of the package.

screenshots.description: Relative paths to screenshot image files, resolved against the manifest directory.

source_dir.description: Source root(s) containing content, relative to the manifest. A single string or a list of strings; with a list, lookup follows declaration order and the first match wins. There is no fallback to the manifest directory when source_dir is declared.

min_edgetx_version.description: Minimum EdgeTX firmware version required. Complete semver, no wildcard.

max_edgetx_version.description: Maximum EdgeTX firmware version supported. 'x' is allowed in the patch position only, and means any patch level within that MAJOR.MINOR (e.g. '2.13.x').

binary.description: Set to true to allow .luac bytecode installation.

capabilities.description: Hardware capability requirements for this package.

variants.description: Alternate manifests for different radio hardware profiles. A variant manifest MUST NOT itself declare variants. See docs/Manifest.md#variants.

packageBlock.$comment: additionalProperties is true so that unknown keys are ignored rather than rejected. A MINOR format bump may add optional fields here, and older tooling must still accept the manifest. See docs/Manifest.md#edgetx_format_version.

requirement.$comment: additionalProperties is true so that unknown keys are ignored rather than rejected. A MINOR format bump may add optional fields here, and older tooling must still accept the manifest. See docs/Manifest.md#edgetx_format_version.

email.description: Author email. `format: email` is a weak assertion — it accepts `a@` and `@b.com` — so a manifest is not rejected over an unparseable address. See docs/Manifest.md#package-fields.

author.$comment: additionalProperties is true so that unknown keys are ignored rather than rejected. A MINOR format bump may add optional fields here, and older tooling must still accept the manifest. See docs/Manifest.md#edgetx_format_version.

projectUrl.$comment: additionalProperties is true so that unknown keys are ignored rather than rejected. A MINOR format bump may add optional fields here, and older tooling must still accept the manifest. See docs/Manifest.md#edgetx_format_version.

capabilities.$comment: additionalProperties is true so that an older implementation can LOAD a newer manifest rather than reject it. It is NOT permission to add fields here in a MINOR bump: this object is used as a variant entry's selection filter, where every field feeds specificity and specificity chooses which build installs — so ignoring one installs a different variant. Adding a capability field is MAJOR. See docs/Manifest.md#edgetx_format_version.

displayCapabilities.description: Display hardware requirements. Every field is optional; an omitted field matches anything.

touch.description: true requires a touchscreen; false requires a non-touchscreen device; omitted matches both.

displayCapabilities.$comment: additionalProperties is true so that unknown keys are ignored rather than rejected. A MINOR format bump may add optional fields here, and older tooling must still accept the manifest. See docs/Manifest.md#edgetx_format_version.

variant.description: Variant entry in a base manifest's variants list. The filter here — capabilities and firmware bounds — is used for selection only; it is not merged into the variant manifest.

path.description: Relative path to the variant manifest, resolved against the base manifest's directory. Must end in .yml or .yaml and must not escape that directory.

capabilities.description: Capability filter used to auto-select this variant.

min_edgetx_version.description: Selection filter: this variant is a candidate only when the running firmware is at least this version. Same grammar as the package-level field. Filter only — it does not constrain installation.

max_edgetx_version.description: Selection filter: this variant is a candidate only when the running firmware is at most this version. `x` allowed in the patch position, as at package level. Filter only — it does not constrain installation.

variant.$comment: additionalProperties is true so that an older implementation can LOAD a newer manifest rather than reject it. It is NOT permission to add filter fields in a MINOR bump: every field here feeds selection and specificity, and specificity chooses which build installs, so ignoring one installs a different variant. Adding a field to a variant entry is MAJOR. See docs/Manifest.md#edgetx_format_version.

contentItem.description: A single installable content item (tool, widget, library, etc.).

name.description: Name for this content item. Identifies it in diagnostics; never used to build the install destination.

path.description: Source path relative to the source root. Also the SD card destination when `dest` is absent — and then it must additionally satisfy the destination rules, including the PKG/ reservation, which the allOf below enforces. With `dest` set it is a pure repository path and PKG/ is not reserved in it. A value of '.' means the source root itself and requires `dest`. See docs/Manifest.md#source-and-destination.

dest.description: SD card destination, relative to the SD card root. Required when `path` is '.'. Never inherits source_dir.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files to skip during copy. See docs/Manifest.md#exclude-patterns.

dev.description: Development-only item: excluded from install and update unless --dev is passed.

then.$comment: path '.' means the manifest directory; without dest it would install into the SD card root.

With no dest, path IS the destination, so it takes the destination rules too — notably the PKG/ reservation. With a dest it is only a source path, and a repository is entitled to have a PKG/ directory of its own.

contentItem.$comment: additionalProperties is true so that unknown keys are ignored rather than rejected. A MINOR format bump may add optional fields here, and older tooling must still accept the manifest. See docs/Manifest.md#edgetx_format_version.

repoRelativePath.description: A relative path inside the package repository, never an install destination. Same rules as safeRelativePath except that 'PKG/' is not reserved, since nothing here is written to the SD card. See docs/Manifest.md#path-rules.
